calling_convention.inputs: $s0 is an index into the 8-byte table at 0x8805e310; $t2 points to the destination object record
calling_convention.return: No explicit return value; $s0 is overwritten while the table entry is applied

reads: word 0 and bytes 4, 6, and 7 of animation table entry 0x8805e310 + $s0 * 8

original.discovery_notes: Reached by both the type-0x14 contact transition and the type-0x1a hit-particle constructor. Entry index 12 installs script 0x8805e6f2 in the first controlled Endokuken particle.

commands: flatpak run org.mamedev.MAME kinst -rompath assets/ki1 -debug -nodrc -debugscript mame/oracle_ki15d_880063ac.cmd -video none -sound none -nothrottle -skip_gameinfo -seconds_to_run 4 -cfg_directory work/mame/cfg -diff_directory work/mame/diff
verification.notes: Four controlled R4600 calls cover original animation-table indexes 0, 3, and 12 plus a synthetic row whose bytes 6 and 7 differ. Index 12 is also the entry seen in the live hit-particle path. The native test compares the complete 1 MiB mapped RAM image after each call.
